capabilities: Manage multiple projects and issues as local Markdown files with labels, milestones, assignees and due dates
View issues as lists, Kanban boards or tables with search, filters, sorting and drag-to-change-state
Write Markdown descriptions and comments with status history, sub-issues and dependencies
Run an optional loopback HTTP API and gh-style agent CLI with JSON output for editing issues
Attach files, paste images and use native Obsidian links with revision checks on edits
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Interface language is Simplified Chinese. CLI and local API are desktop-only, off by default, and the API binds to 127.0.0.1 only; no account, payment or telemetry. Manual zip installation from GitHub Releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in issue or project tracking with statuses, boards, comment threads and assignees, and external trackers keep that data outside the vault.
summary: GitHub Issues-style project tracker that stores projects, issues, boards, comments and attachments as readable Markdown files in the vault.
